The scheduled monthly payment \(P\) for a loan of \$20 000 at 6 % annual interest compounded monthly (monthly rate \(i=0.005\)) over 60 months is  

\[
P=\frac{20000\,i}{1-(1+i)^{-60}}
   =\frac{100}{1-(1.005)^{-60}}\approx 386.6564 .
\]

Each month the borrower also pays an extra \$100 of principal, so the total payment each month is  

\[
T=P+100\approx 386.6564+100=486.6564 .
\]

Let \(B_t\) be the outstanding balance after the \(t^{\text{th}}\) payment.  
The recurrence for one period is  

\[
B_t=(1+i)B_{t-1}-T,
\qquad B_0=20000 .
\]

Solving this linear recurrence gives  

\[
B_t = B_0(1+i)^t - T\frac{(1+i)^t-1}{i}.
\]

For \(t=12\),

* \((1+i)^{12}=1.005^{12}\approx 1.0616778094\);
* \(\displaystyle \frac{(1+i)^{12}-1}{i}
   =\frac{0.0616778094}{0.005}=12.33556188\).

Hence  

\[
\begin{aligned}
B_{12}&=20000\,(1.005)^{12}
        - T\frac{(1.005)^{12}-1}{0.005}\\[2mm]
      &=20000\times 1.0616778094
        -486.6564\times 12.33556188\\[2mm]
      &\approx 21\,233.556188-6\,003.18014\\[2mm]
      &\approx 15\,230.37605 .
\end{aligned}
\]

Rounded to the nearest cent, the balance after the 12th monthly payment is  

\[
\boxed{15230.38}.
\]
